items.title: MacBook Neo is so popular that Apple doubled production
items.raw_content: On an earnings call in late April, Apple's CEO Tim Cook said that customer response to the MacBook Neo was "off the charts," and the popularity of the laptop has reportedly led the company to significantly boost production. Apple supply chain analyst Ming-Chi Kuo this week said he believes that MacBook Neo shipments to Apple were doubled from an initial target of 5 million units to 10 million units in 2026 at some point after the laptop launched in March.
items.title_zh: MacBook Neo 太受欢迎，苹果将产量翻倍

items.title: A 10 year old Xeon is all you need

items.summary: A blog post describes running Gemma 4 — a 25B-parameter mixture-of-experts model — on a 2016 Xeon with no GPU, 128 GB of DDR3 and 25 flags.

items.summary: A report finds that UK media outlets failed to disclose defence-sector links in nearly 60% of cases.

items.title: Fine-tuning an LLM to write docs like it's 1995
items.title_zh: 微调 LLM，写出 1995 年风格的文档
items.summary: The author fine-tuned an instruct model to write documentation in the style of software technical writers from the 1980s and 1990s, as an early experiment toward the specialized local LLMs he predicted technical writers will use by 2030.

items.title: GrapheneOS user reported to authorities for using GrapheneOS
items.title_zh: GrapheneOS 用户因使用 GrapheneOS 被举报给当局
items.summary: A GrapheneOS forum post relays a user's account of the Yoti age-verification service automatically flagging devices that run GrapheneOS and reporting them to authorities and its own security team.

items.title: The Smart TV in Your LivingRoom Is a Node in the AIScraping Economy
items.title_zh: 你客厅里的智能电视，是 AI 抓取经济中的一个节点
items.summary: An Include Security post examines Bright Data's SDK and how it turns ordinary consumer TVs into exit nodes of a large commercial residential proxy network that the AI industry uses to scrape web data and train language models.

items.title: Major P2P issues in Israel and possibly other Middle East countries
items.title_zh: 以色列及可能其他中东国家出现严重 P2P 连接问题
items.summary: A user report on the GameNetworkingSockets issue tracker describes a major systemic peer-to-peer problem in Israel and possibly other Middle Eastern countries since around March 13, saying game and Steam support offered no help.

items.title: Vitamin D3 During Pregnancy and Cognitive Performance at 10 Years

items.summary: A JAMA Network Open article examines the link between vitamin D3 during pregnancy and cognitive performance in children at 10 years.

items.summary: A distributional analysis of every rsync release with bug data asks whether Claude-assisted releases were unusually buggy, with the author explaining the methodology in advance to pre-empt charges of bias or hallucination.

items.title_zh: Foxconn 与 Intel 合作开发下一代 AI 基础设施
items.summary: Foxconn, formally Hon Hai Precision Industry, said it would partner with US chipmaker Intel to develop and deploy next-generation AI infrastructure, TechNode reports.

items.summary: NetEase Games' party game Eggy Party launched on Windows, bringing the full experience to PC players with cross-platform accounts and data.

items.summary: oh-my-taiyiforge is a TypeScript plugin for AI workflow automation that targets intelligent code generation with Claude and Codex.

items.title_zh: Check-Risk-WAF：一体化 Web 应用防火墙
items.summary: An all-in-one web application firewall with anti-bot and anti-DDoS protection at layers 3, 4 and 7, offered on-premises or as SaaS and free and unlimited for personal, non-commercial use.

items.summary: A Python agent pitched as an AI adviser for Chinese college-entrance-exam applications, described as asking follow-up questions, analyzing options and being willing to tell hard truths.

items.title: inkeep/open-knowledge
items.title_zh: inkeep/open-knowledge：AI 原生 Markdown IDE 与 LLM wiki
items.summary: An AI-native markdown IDE and LLM wiki from inkeep, written in TypeScript.

items.title: ScrapeCreators/social-media-research-skills
items.title_zh: ScrapeCreators/social-media-research-skills：社交媒体研究的 AI Agent 技能
items.summary: A Python collection of AI agent skills for social media research, covering outlier posts, comment mining, competitor teardowns and ad libraries across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Reddit, X and LinkedIn, compatible with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Gemini CLI.

items.title: vorpus/performativeUI
items.title_zh: vorpus/performativeUI
items.summary: A TypeScript repository trending on GitHub whose listing offers no description beyond its language.

items.title: KForge: LLM-Driven Cross-Platform Kernel Generation for AI Accelerators
items.title_zh: KForge：面向 AI 加速器的 LLM 驱动跨平台内核生成
items.summary: KForge pairs a kernel-generation agent with a performance-analysis agent in an iterative refinement loop; it improves end-to-end throughput by 2.12% over TensorRT-LLM on NVIDIA B200 and generates Triton kernels with a 5.13× geometric-mean speedup on Intel Arc B580 across 37 KernelBench Level 2 workloads.

items.title: CAD-to-CT Registration of Cylindrical Objects via Ellipse-Based Axis Estimation
items.title_zh: 基于椭圆轴估计的圆柱物体 CAD-CT 配准
items.summary: A two-stage method estimates a cylindrical object's 3D axis from elliptical cross-sections in CT slices, then aligns a voxelized CAD model by maximizing volumetric overlap, reaching tilt and orientation errors below 0.1° without intensity calibration.

items.title: Scaling Novel Graph Generation via Lightweight Structure-Guided Autoregressive Models
items.title_zh: 用轻量级结构引导自回归模型扩展新颖图生成
items.summary: A lightweight autoregressive framework serializes graphs into regular edge sequences via a structure-guided topological ordering for near log-linear generation, improving novelty while preserving validity and uniqueness on molecular and non-molecular benchmarks.

items.title: MedSIGHT: Towards Grounded Visual Comprehension in Medical Large Vision-Language Models
items.title_zh: MedSIGHT：面向医疗大视觉语言模型的有据视觉理解
items.summary: MedSIGHT is a unified framework that gives medical vision-language models region-centric tokens and a medical region codebook, so the model can emit discrete region codes that decode into segmentation masks; trained on 72K instruction pairs, it reports state-of-the-art results on medical comprehension and segmentation.

items.title: CATPO: Critique-Augmented Tree Policy Optimization
items.title_zh: CATPO：批评增强的树策略优化
items.summary: CATPO scores tree-structured rollouts for informativeness, uses natural-language critiques to repair trees in which every branch fails, and weights the loss by that score. On Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B it reached 37.5% macro accuracy across AIME24, MATH-500, OlympiadBench and MinervaMath, 1.9% above TreeRPO and 4.8% above GRPO.

items.title: sGPO: Trading Inference FLOPs for Training Efficiency in RLVR
items.title_zh: sGPO：在 RLVR 中以推理 FLOPs 换取训练效率
items.summary: The paper proposes sorted Group Policy Optimization, which spends a small batch of parallel samples under the initial policy to estimate each query's difficulty, then sets rollout group size to the inverse success rate and uses the same pass to filter data and build a curriculum. It matches or exceeds baselines while cutting total training compute by a factor of three, including the profiling cost.
